variant_decisions.evidence: Orthographic qere/ketiv only: qere קְרִיאֵ֣י and ketiv קרואי are the same lexeme (plural construct of the passive adjective 'called ones'), differing solely in the internal mater (א/ו). ASV 'who were called of the congregation' renders either spelling identically, and NUM.26.9 carries no mapped textual note. Nothing in the English distinguishes them, so both remain compatible and the qere base fallback carries the projection.
